According to [1], the SEP cargo stage in the SEP-Chem Evolvable Mars Campaign architecture was assumed to supply 150 kW of power to its electric propulsion thrusters.

Additionally, [2] states that the power to the EP system is 150 kW, with a power level that decreases with distance from the Sun, specifically 1/R^2 for R>1AU.

[3] also mentions that the SEP cargo analysis examined performance to Mars as a function of thruster power levels starting from the 40 kW ARRM power upward to 300 kW, but the SEP stage in the SEP-Chem Evolvable Mars Campaign architecture was specifically assumed to supply 150 kW of power.

[4] and [5] do not provide information on the power level of the SEP cargo stage in the SEP-Chem Evolvable Mars Campaign architecture.
